videos.caption: Fix this one thing and everything else gets easier.

videos.title: Answering the question I get every single week

videos.title: A client's before-and-after, six months in
videos.hook: She almost quit in week three. Here's what week 24 looks like.
videos.overview: A real client transformation story, focused on the mindset shift not just the physical change.
videos.filmingDirection: Interview style with the client, plus b-roll of a session.
videos.caption: The physical change is the easy part to show. The mindset shift is the real story.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Open on the week-3 low point (told in her own words), build through the middle, land on where she is now.
editorBrief.mustKeep: The line where she says "I almost texted you to cancel."
editorBrief.captionsStyle: Burned-in captions, clean sans-serif, bottom third.
editorBrief.musicVibe: Understated build, not triumphant until the final 5 seconds.
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Your week 3 doesn't decide your week 24.
editorBrief.platformSpecs: 9:16, under 45s, safe zone clear of bottom nav.

videos.title: The truth about rest days
videos.hook: You're not lazy for needing a rest day. You're smart.

videos.caption: Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.

editorBrief.storyBeats: Direct address, myth then correction, twice, then CTA.
editorBrief.mustKeep: The line "rest is part of the plan, not a break from it" — verbatim, don't trim.
editorBrief.ctaOverlay: Save this for your next rest-day guilt trip.

videos.title: Three questions to ask before hiring any coach
